purpose: Extend the Ly-Tran pilot reference set toward later medieval equipment without treating a broad collection date as an individual object date.

observations: The museum identifies the Ngoc Khanh weapons collection as 111 objects, including edged weapons and firearms.
The collection is dated broadly to the 15th-18th centuries. This does not date any particular photographed weapon to the 15th century.
